description: Defines a generic serializable class 'StreamCheckpoint<TState>' used to track stream processing state, including tokens and an accumulator, within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: StreamCheckpoint<TState>
classes.description: A serializable class for checkpointing stream processing state, including stream identifiers, tokens, and an accumulator.

methods.name: RecoveryToken
methods.description: Property that returns the last processed token or the start token if none processed.

methods.name: IsDuplicate
methods.description: Checks if a given sequence token is a duplicate based on the last processed and start tokens.

methods.name: TryUpdateStartToken
methods.description: Attempts to set the start token if it is currently null.
